about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in a serene frozen world as a penguin in this atmospheric action-adventure. Wander across icy fields and majestic glaciers, exploring beautifully stylized low-poly landscapes at your own pace. Use your unique abilities to interact subtly with the environment, shaping the ice and navigating obstacles along the way.

The game places music and sound at the heart of the experience, creating a deeply immersive and relaxing atmosphere that complements the visual beauty of the polar world.

Key Features:

  • Explore expansive, frozen landscapes in a stylized low-poly 3D world

  • Engage with the environment using subtle, penguin-inspired abilities

  • Enjoy a rich musical and sound design that enhances immersion

  • Experience a calm, atmospheric journey perfect for relaxing exploration

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 380
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
